text_block_list.text:
February is here. With the Osaka Hai
fast
approaching, Эйр Грув is bursting
with the
desire to surpass Silence
Suzuka.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In an attempt to stay apace with Air
Groove's
enthusiasm, I end up working
deep into the night.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
One day, after training with Эйр Грув,
I'm
sitting in my office when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Excuse me.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
It's rather late. Burning the midnight oil,
are you?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list: Well, the Osaka Hai is coming up.

text_block_list.text: Indeed...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Just don't push yourself too hard. Our
health is
our greatest asset. I can't have
you collapsing
when I need you most.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Please do.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: How about some tea?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: No. You stay right where you are.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув's tone doesn't leave any
room for
argument, so I remain seated
and continue
working, until...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Plunk...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...a mug is placed on my desk. A sweet
aroma
wafts up from the beverage.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It appears that Эйр Грув has made me
some hot
chocolate.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Drink up. The temperature is due to
drop again
today. This should help keep
you alert.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I do as she says. Warmth floods
throughout my
body as I consume the
sweet drink.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Consider it a small thank-you for your
help every
day.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Besides, you know how much I like my
holidays.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, it suddenly occurs to me
that today
is Valentine's Day.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I have to be up early tomorrow, so I'll be
taking
my leave now.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Be sure to savor each sip.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: ...a cup of coffee is placed on my desk.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Also... take this too.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Sugar helps a tired brain. Open it up and
have
some.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I open the wrapped package she hands
me to find
a beautiful box of chocolates.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Seeing her sudden gift, I realize that
today is
Valentine's Day.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Judging by your expression, it appears
you had
forgotten what day it is.
Consider this a token of
thanks for your
help every day.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
...Enough with the staring. Hurry up and
eat.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I eat one of the chocolates. It's sweet
with bitter
undertones—a rich and
sophisticated flavor.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I'm glad to hear it.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
A word of advice. While it may be true
that
beautiful flowers grow in troubled
soil...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Nothing good comes from toil for the
sake of it.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Even the toughest of flowers eventually
need
nourishment. It's when the drought
ends and rain
finally falls that they
bloom most brightly.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Don't push yourself too hard. Take some
time off
to eat something sweet once in
a while.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
And... I want to tell you that you're
doing a good
job. That's all.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I have to be up early tomorrow, so I'll be
taking
my leave now.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Judging by her manner of speech, I
wonder if Air
Groove was a little
embarrassed.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All the same, I can sense her kindness in
the
chocolates she gave me. I eat
another and enjoy
the warmth that fills
me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув's kindness warms me—heart,
body,
and soul.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
